name: Prefix-2 Littlestone Dimension / 2-Block Littlestone Dimension
details: For every finite binary class, $\mathrm{PL}_2(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{B}_2(\mathcal H)$.
proof_source: Full proof in the LaTeX survey: Proposition \ref{prop:block-prefix-littlestone}.
witness_verification: Fix k=2 and m=1 in #classes/cube_halfinterval_product. For n>=8 the established exact endpoint values are PL_2=1+floor(log_2 n) and B_2=3. Hence PL_2/(1+B_2) tends to infinity as n tends to infinity, excluding every reverse affine bound. The value proofs are database-owned; see also survey Corollary prop:cube-halfinterval-separations.
